contexts.text: Me ye have bereaved () = that there was thus no more a Church... To bereave = to deprive the Church of its truths and goods, as here of those things which are represented by Joseph, Benjamin, and Simeon. Explained, Illustrated.

And I, as I have been bereaved, I shall be bereaved () = that the Church will be deprived of its truths before these things are done... To be bereaved = to be deprived of the truths which are of the Church.
Bereavement () = the deprivation of truth and good.
The sword which shall no more bereave () = that falsity will not destroy truth any more.
